card.name: Nouns like configuration and injection before site/files
card.fires_on: A noun that is the head of a short compound, such as 'configuration' before 'files', 'injection' before 'sites', or 'sensor' before 'glucose'. It also fires on the end of the drug name pramlintide and the start of INCRELEX.
